# JobSphere

> JobSphere is a free job board listing current job openings in Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, South Sudan, Ethiopia and Ghana, plus remote jobs. Job seekers browse and apply free; employers can post jobs free after review.

## Main pages
- [All jobs](https://www.jobsphere.net/jobs): Current listings, filterable by country, job type and keyword
- [Remote jobs](https://www.jobsphere.net/remote-jobs): Remote roles open to African applicants
- [Job categories](https://www.jobsphere.net/categories): Jobs grouped by industry
- [Post a job](https://www.jobsphere.net/post-job): Free employer job posting, reviewed before going live
- [Career blog](https://www.jobsphere.net/blog): East African job-market and career guides
- [Resume builder](https://www.jobsphere.net/resume-builder): Free CV builder
- [Contact](https://www.jobsphere.net/contact): Kagoma, Kampala, Uganda · +256 757 330656

## Notes
- Countries covered: 7 (Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, South Sudan, Ethiopia, Ghana) plus remote.
- Listings expire and are removed when outdated.
